facts.fact: The SIXP administrator, in a 26 August 2015 AfPIF talk, lists as a challenge that no carrier-neutral data centres are available in The Gambia, citing high operating cost and lack of economies of scale; the statement covers carrier-neutral facilities only, and says most websites are hosted abroad because local hosting is costly.
